sources.scope: October 8 Google Developers publisher analysis of AQuA: representative agent trace sampling, review checks, failure clustering and transcript verification, out-of-request-path diagnosis with pinned source snapshots and no automatic source edits.

October 7 GitHub publisher changelog: generally available local Copilot CLI/App/VS Code Agent Host sandbox with OS-level filesystem, network and credential permissions, separate from model decision quality.

October 8 Microsoft publisher product announcement: thirty Dynamics 365 prebuilt skills, customer CRM grounding in Teams, proposed record edits and approval points, with general-availability versus private/public preview distinctions.

October 7 OpenAI publisher article: Intelligent UI converts answers into interactive diagrams and controls, uses progressive streamable UI components and a compiler, and discloses staged product availability rather than universal access.

October 8 Google Cloud announcement: modular reusable skill prompts, global/team/personal registries, enterprise tool registry and governed tool selection, procedural memory and differentiated preview versus released claims.

October 8 Anthropic publisher item independently read in full text: paid-plan beta dashboards connected to live business data, visible source queries and freshness, motion explainer distinction and limitations of announced features.

agent_skills_evidence.explanation: Google Cloud's October 8 original announcement explicitly defines Agent Skills as reusable modular prompts containing instructions, knowledge and multi-step workflows. It describes global, shared company and personal skill registries, governed tool-selection and procedural memory. A bounded business procedure can therefore be repackaged and repeated without reauthoring every action; availability and adoption claims remain publisher claims, not independent general-use proof.
